name: fidelity
title: Source fidelity markers
description: Verbatim quotes, "beyond the source" tags and erratum boxes, so readers can tell the source's words from yours.

beyondLabel.description: Text of an empty inline tag.

beyondBlockLabel.description: Label added to a <div class="beyond-block"> that has no .lbl of its own.

erratumLabel.description: Label of an <div class="erratum"> box whose .lbl is empty or missing.

legend.description: Add a one-line legend explaining the markers at the top of every unit page. A page can opt out with front matter "fidelityLegend": false.

legendText.default: Indented quotes are the source's exact wording. {beyond} marks material added beyond the source. {erratum} boxes correct a mistake in the source.
legendText.description: Legend text (HTML allowed). {beyond} and {erratum} become small samples of those markers.

legendLabel.description: Accessible name of the legend; also shown before it when legendShowLabel is true.

legendShowLabel.description: Show legendLabel as a visible prefix of the legend line.

legendKinds.description: Page kinds that get the legend (list of kind names); null = every kind.

quoteAliases.description: Other class names that mark verbatim quotes, e.g. ["slide"]: <blockquote> and <q> elements with one of them are styled as quotes too (they also get the quote class), so existing markup needs no renaming.
